steps.title: Run the Linux ARM64 package
steps.instruction: Extract the release ZIP, then unpack DK64Recompiled.tar.gz. Start DK64Recompiled from the extracted folder. The current ARM64 build needs glibc 2.35 or newer, SDL2, GTK 3, libatomic, libcurl and a Vulkan-capable driver.

steps.title: Install the Linux x64 Flatpak
steps.instruction: Extract the Flatpak x64 ZIP to get io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled.flatpak. Install the file with Flatpak, then start io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled from the app menu or with flatpak run io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled.

steps.title: Open the Mac app
steps.instruction: Choose the official Apple Silicon ZIP. Extract the outer release ZIP, then use Archive Utility to extract DK64Recompiled.zip to get DK64Recompiled.app. Open the app from its permanent folder.

steps.title: Select your original
steps.instruction: In the upstream game picker choose your own USA 1.0 Donkey Kong 64 cartridge dump. The game validates the matching original before play.

warnings: These packages use upstream or player-managed setup, replacement and data backups. Portcove has no native execution or populated-save result for these sibling packages.

references.title: Keep the external profile
references.instruction: Preserve ~/.config/DK64Recompiled on Linux and the DK64Recompiled profile under ~/Library/Application Support on Mac, or your actual custom profile. For Flatpak also keep ~/.var/app/io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled. Back up the original, saves, mods and settings before replacing an upstream copy.
